title: It can change
the result of the test.
shop.text: A page that **jumps** gets noticed, moves things under the finger and feels broken. A visitor who saw that does not behave like the others, so the test measures **the flicker as well as your change**.
shop.label: The gentleman in front of a shop window where a page has jumped

title: What it means
for you.

text.agency: I set your clients’ tests up so that **the change is made before the page is shown**. Their customers **never see a page jump**, and your tests measure your change and nothing else. I check it on each store **before the test goes live**.
text.brand: I set your tests up so that **the change is made before the page is shown**. Your customers **never see a page jump**, and your tests measure your change and nothing else. I check it on your store **before the test goes live**.

workshop.label: The gentleman at a workshop with a hanging sign: no flicker

drawers.label: Slow connections
drawers.question: And on a slow connection?
drawers.answer: I set **a limit** for each test. If the change is not ready in time, the visitor gets **the original page**: nobody is left in front of an empty screen.

drawers.label: After the test
drawers.question: And when the test is over?
drawers.answer: When a version wins, I can **build it into the theme** and remove the test. From then on nothing is changed on the fly: there is **no flicker to avoid, and no wait**.

drawers.label: Counted once
drawers.question: And a visitor who comes back?
drawers.answer: They see **the version they saw the first time**, and are counted once. The same person **never counts twice** in the result.

drawers.label: Switching it off
drawers.question: And if something goes wrong?
drawers.answer: You can **switch a test off yourself**, at once. Every visitor then gets **the original page**.

answer.agency: Without flicker, the page is shown **a little later**. How much depends on the test, on the size of the change and on the visitor’s connection. I **measure it** on each store before the test goes live.
answer.brand: Without flicker, the page is shown **a little later**. How much depends on the test, on the size of the change and on the visitor’s connection. I **measure it** on your store before the test goes live.

promises: Confirmed by Dylan on 15 Nov 2026: he checks and measures on every test before it goes live.
On a slow connection: a limit, then the original page. Nothing is said about the result.
Building the winner into the theme is an offer (“I can”), not something that always happens.
No figure is given for the delay, on purpose: never add one.
